Success runs the true action; failure or unmet conditions run the false action. Formulas use 10000 = 100% and are clamped to 0–100%. Unmet conditions consume no random draws. Both 0% and 100% consume one draw. Calculation uses current state, including earlier effects, once per step regardless of parent quantity.
